page.title: Video
page.subtitle: Create video clips from a prompt, locally

model.noneInCatalog: No video models are listed for this engine.

model.title: Choose a video model
model.description: We picked the best version of each model for this computer.

card.title: Create videos with Local AI
card.description: Turn text or a picture into video right on your computer. To start, install the media engine, then download a model.

form.title: Create videos
form.hint: Generate a short clip from a prompt
form.promptPlaceholder: Describe the scene and how it moves…
form.negativeHint: What to steer the clip away from. Only used when guidance is above 1.
form.resolutionHint: The frame size. Each model offers the sizes it was trained at.
form.durationHint: How long the clip plays. Frame counts follow the model's own grid.
form.stepsHint: Denoising passes. More is slower and rarely helps past the model default.
form.guidanceHint: How strictly the prompt is followed. Higher is stricter and slower to converge.
form.distilledGuidanceHint: Distilled guidance strength for models that expose it.
form.resetHint: Put the settings back to the model defaults. The prompt stays.
